points.K7: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起
points.K9: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么
points.K14: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受
points.K15: 有疑问就问，有建议就提

points.K17: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室走廊，墙上一面空白安全宣传栏，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab corridor beside a blank safety bulletin board and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲安全文化。

shots.scene: 三个图标：一群小人、举手喊停、交谈气泡
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a group of people pictograms, a raised hand signaling stop, and two speech bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不只靠制度，更靠大家的习惯。

shots.scene: 检查日，王老师巡查，实验室整整齐齐，人人戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: On inspection day, the safety administrator walks through a tidy lab where everyone wears safety goggles.
shots.narration: 检查那天，一切都很好。

shots.scene: 周五深夜，阿杰一个人又累又赶，护目镜挂在额头上，跳过一步
shots.prompt_en: Late Friday night, the tired young male student works alone in a hurry, goggles pushed up on his forehead, skipping a step.
shots.narration: 周五深夜，又累又赶，没人看着。

shots.scene: 欣欣对镜头摊手，头顶问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its paws at the camera, a question mark above its head.
shots.narration: 这时的实验室，还安全吗？

shots.section_title: 安全文化：不假思索的共同习惯
shots.scene: 实验室里每个人进门都自然地戴护目镜，像条件反射
shots.prompt_en: Each person entering the lab naturally puts on safety goggles without thinking, like a habit.
shots.narration: 安全文化，是一群人共同的习惯。
overlay: 安全文化：不假思索的共同习惯

shots.section_title: 安全文化：不假思索的共同习惯
shots.scene: 行为、信念、价值、符号四个图标围成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a circle: a hand action, a lightbulb belief, a heart value, and a shield symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 是行为、信念、价值和符号。

shots.section_title: 安全文化：不假思索的共同习惯
shots.scene: 日历一页页翻过，小树慢慢长大
shots.prompt_en: Calendar pages flip by while a small tree slowly grows taller. No people.
shots.narration: 不是一夜养成，要亲自参与。

shots.scene: 书架上一本厚厚的空白安全手册落满灰
shots.prompt_en: A thick blank safety manual sits dusty on a shelf. No people.
shots.narration: 手册写得再好，也可能只在架上。

shots.scene: 阿杰独自一人仍认真戴好护目镜、拉低通风柜门
shots.prompt_en: Alone in the lab, the young male student still puts on goggles and lowers the fume hood sash properly.
shots.narration: 没人看着时怎么做，由文化决定。

shots.scene: 台面上倒液、放瓶、丢废物三个动作图标
shots.prompt_en: Three action icons on a lab bench: pouring, placing a bottle, discarding waste. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不在文件夹里，在实验台上。

shots.scene: 只靠检查撑着的脚手架一松就塌
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold held up only by an inspection clipboard collapses when the clipboard is removed. No people.
shots.narration: 只靠检查撑着，一松就垮。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 地面一条底线，上方一道向上的阶梯
shots.prompt_en: A baseline on the ground with a staircase rising high above it. No people.
shots.narration: 合规是底线，告诉你最低要求。
overlay: 合规是底线，文化定高度

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 一流的设备旁，有人为赶时间跳步骤
shots.prompt_en: Next to modern equipment, a pictogram of a person skipping a procedure step to save time. No people.
shots.narration: 设备一流，人还是会为赶快跳步骤。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 天平上快的一端轻、稳的一端被奖杯压下
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale where the steady side holds a trophy and outweighs the fast side with a stopwatch. No people.
shots.narration: 要让稳妥，比快更受认可。

shots.section_title: 合规是底线，文化定高度
shots.scene: 打勾应付的表格和一棵长大的树对比
shots.prompt_en: A checklist being ticked mechanically next to a growing tree. No people.
shots.narration: 是打勾应付，还是建设文化？

shots.scene: 五级台阶，第一级上一个小人捂住问题
shots.prompt_en: Five steps; on the lowest one a pictogram hides a problem under a rug. No people.
shots.narration: 最低一级：不被发现就行，掩盖问题。

shots.scene: 第二级：出了事才拿扳手去修
shots.prompt_en: On the second step, a pictogram fixes something with a wrench only after an accident icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二级：出了事，才去整改。

shots.scene: 第三级：检查表和制度推着小人走
shots.prompt_en: On the third step, a checklist and a rule book push a pictogram forward. No people.
shots.narration: 第三级：靠检查和制度推着走。

shots.scene: 第四级望远镜看前方危险，第五级安全融入每个决定
shots.prompt_en: On the fourth step a pictogram looks ahead with a telescope at hazards; on the top step safety icons fill every decision. No people.
shots.narration: 再往上，主动预判，安全融入每个决定。

shots.scene: 日历翻过好几年，小人一步步往上爬
shots.prompt_en: Calendar years flip by as the pictogram climbs up the steps one at a time. No people.
shots.narration: 提升一级要好几年，贵在坚持。

shots.section_title: 人人有责：安全是大家的事
shots.scene: 许多只手共同托起一个盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Many hands together hold up a large shield. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不是一个人的事，是大家的事。
overlay: 人人有责：安全是大家的事

shots.section_title: 人人有责：安全是大家的事
shots.scene: 实验室危险图标，旁边一群小人的大小决定风险条长短
shots.prompt_en: Lab hazard icons with a risk bar whose length depends on the people around it. No people.
shots.narration: 风险有多大，取决于你和身边的人。

shots.section_title: 人人有责：安全是大家的事
shots.scene: 小研及时擦掉一处溢洒，走廊里的人安然走过
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student promptly wipes up a small spill, and people in the corridor pass safely.
shots.narration: 护好自己，也护好同伴、公众和环境。

shots.section_title: 人人有责：安全是大家的事
shots.scene: 规程、培训、人人讲安全三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a procedure binder, a training session, and a group of people with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 有规程、有培训，人人讲安全。

shots.scene: 大脑、手、心三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a brain, a hand, and a heart. No people.
shots.narration: 安全需要知识、技能，更需要态度。

shots.scene: 阿杰装备齐全却分心看手机的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a fully equipped person distracted by a phone, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 装备再全，一分心也会出事。

shots.scene: 重视、不冒险、推动、承担四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a valued shield, a no gambling sign, a pushing arrow, and a hand holding responsibility. No people.
shots.narration: 重视安全，不冒险，主动承担责任。

shots.scene: 安全的实验台和一份漂亮的数据报告并列
shots.prompt_en: A safe tidy lab bench next to a neat data report with a star. No people.
shots.narration: 好的科学，从安全开始。

shots.section_title: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起
shots.scene: 课程和手册图标，箭头指向阿杰
shots.prompt_en: A course icon and a manual icon with arrows pointing to the young male student.
shots.narration: 课程和手册只是信息，用起来靠自己。
overlay: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起

shots.section_title: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起
shots.scene: 阿杰对着镜子整理护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student adjusts his goggles in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 对你安全负最大责任的，是你自己。

shots.section_title: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起
shots.scene: 小研第一个戴好护目镜，其他人跟着戴
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student is the first to put on goggles, and others follow her example.
shots.narration: 改变先从自己做起，不等别人先动。

shots.section_title: 最终责任在自己，改变从我做起
shots.scene: 日历每天都打勾，循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with a check every day and a continuous improvement arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 安全不是一次任务，要天天坚持。

shots.scene: 乱糟糟的台面被打叉，整洁有序的台面打勾
shots.prompt_en: A messy cluttered bench crossed out, and a tidy organized bench with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 安全文化差，常因为不专业。

shots.scene: 采购、使用、处置、消毒四个环节连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four linked icons in a loop: purchase, use, disposal, decontamination. No people.
shots.narration: 全流程，靠素养、条理和沟通。

shots.scene: 小研操作时抬眼观察周围
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks up from her work to check her surroundings.
shots.narration: 时刻警觉，周围情况心中有数。

shots.section_title: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 老周要求戴护目镜，自己却没戴的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a supervisor demanding goggles while not wearing any himself, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嘴上一套手上一套，没人信。
overlay: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么

shots.section_title: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 老周戴好护目镜走进实验室，学生们跟着学
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears goggles as he enters the lab, and the students follow his example.
shots.narration: 要求别人做的，自己先做到。

shots.section_title: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 新人模仿老人的动作，箭头传递
shots.prompt_en: A new student copies the actions of an experienced one, with arrows passing behavior along. No people.
shots.narration: 老人怎么做，新人就跟着学。

shots.section_title: 说到做到，投入什么就是重视什么
shots.scene: 新的通风柜和洗眼器被装好
shots.prompt_en: A new fume hood and an eyewash station are installed in the lab. No people.
shots.narration: 看得见的投入，比空讲更有说服力。

shots.scene: 老周在组会上说话，气泡里是一群人图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man speaks at a group meeting; his speech bubble shows a group of people icons.
shots.narration: 负责人关注什么，大家就重视什么。

shots.scene: 两个气泡：我们和系统问题被打勾，你和某人失误被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two speech bubbles: one with a group icon and gears checked, one pointing a finger at one person crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 多说我们和系统，少说某人失误。

shots.scene: 老周拍拍喊停的阿杰肩膀表扬
shots.prompt_en: The older man pats the young male student on the shoulder, praising him for calling a stop.
shots.narration: 有人喊停，要表扬。

shots.scene: 气泡里赶紧弄完和催促的时钟被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble with a rushing stopwatch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别说赶紧弄完，那会催出捷径。

shots.scene: 老周走进实验室，在实验台旁弯腰看
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks into the lab and bends down to look closely at a bench.
shots.narration: 负责人走到现场，比开会更管用。

shots.scene: 老周向小研提问，小研比划着回答
shots.prompt_en: The older man asks the female graduate student an open question; she explains with gestures.
shots.narration: 多问开放问题，多看，多听。

shots.scene: 报告数量上升、事故数量下降的两条箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows: reports going up and accidents going down. No people.
shots.narration: 险情报告多了，事故往往少了。

shots.scene: 老周匆匆赶到出事的实验室
shots.prompt_en: The older man hurries to the lab where an incident just happened.
shots.narration: 出了事，负责人要尽快到场。

shots.scene: 老周先关心受伤的阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The older man first checks on the young male student who was slightly hurt.
shots.narration: 先关心受影响的人。

shots.scene: 老周在会上如实通报，白板上空白原因分析图
shots.prompt_en: The older man reports honestly at a meeting, next to a blank cause analysis diagram on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 如实通报，找原因，不找替罪羊。

shots.scene: 推卸责任的手指图标和倒塌的积木
shots.prompt_en: A blame-pointing finger icon next to a collapsing tower of blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 推卸躲闪，文化就会垮掉。

shots.scene: 阿杰看到通风柜报警，举手喊停
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sees a fume hood alarm light and raises his hand to call stop.
shots.narration: 发现危险，人人都可以喊停。

shots.scene: 大家停下操作，阿杰去报告老周
shots.prompt_en: Everyone pauses work while the young male student goes to report to the older man.
shots.narration: 停下来，撤离，再报告负责人。

shots.scene: 强令冒险的手势被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of someone ordering another person into a risky task, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 违章指挥、强令冒险，可以拒绝。

shots.scene: 报告安全问题的小人旁边盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a person reporting a safety issue, protected by a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 报告安全问题，不会受责怪。

shots.section_title: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受
shots.scene: 小研看到阿杰穿着实验服走出实验室，友善地拍拍他
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sees the young male student walking out of the lab in his lab coat and kindly taps his shoulder.
shots.narration: 看到问题，先友善地当面提醒。
overlay: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受

shots.section_title: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受
shots.scene: 阿杰回去脱下实验服，擦拭刚才碰过的桌面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student goes back to take off the lab coat inside and wipes the desk he touched.
shots.narration: 被提醒时说谢谢，马上纠正。

shots.section_title: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受
shots.scene: 提醒气泡指向问题图标而不是人
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble pointing at a problem icon, not at a person. No people.
shots.narration: 提醒的是问题，不是针对人。

shots.section_title: 同伴友善提醒，虚心接受
shots.scene: 反复出现的问题被记录，交给王老师
shots.prompt_en: A recurring problem is noted and passed to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 反复出现的问题，向安全员反映。

shots.section_title: 有疑问就问，有建议就提
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研耐心解释
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask; the female graduate student explains patiently.
shots.narration: 哪一步没把握，先停下来问。
overlay: 有疑问就问，有建议就提

shots.section_title: 有疑问就问，有建议就提
shots.scene: 阿杰把规程改进建议交给老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands a written suggestion about the procedure to the older man.
shots.narration: 规程哪里不好用，大胆说。

shots.section_title: 有疑问就问，有建议就提
shots.scene: 规程版本更新的图标
shots.prompt_en: A procedure sheet with an updated version arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 好建议采纳了，规程就更新。

shots.section_title: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全
shots.scene: 实验开始前，小研和阿杰站在实验台旁简短交流
shots.prompt_en: Before starting, the female graduate student and the young male student have a short talk at the bench.
shots.narration: 工地有班前会，实验室也可以有。
overlay: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全

shots.section_title: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全
shots.scene: 三个图标：做什么、危险在哪、出事怎么办
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a task clipboard, a warning triangle, and an emergency first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 做什么、危险在哪、出事怎么办。

shots.section_title: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全
shots.scene: 组会屏幕上空白的安全页，老周开讲
shots.prompt_en: At a group meeting, the older man opens with a blank safety slide on the screen.
shots.narration: 组会开头，先讲五分钟安全。

shots.section_title: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全
shots.scene: 阿杰讲自己的险情经历，大家点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shares a near-miss story while others nod and take notes.
shots.narration: 说出教训，大家少走弯路。

shots.section_title: 实验前五分钟，组会讲安全
shots.scene: 好经验写进规程夹
shots.prompt_en: A good practice note is filed into the procedure binder. No people.
shots.narration: 好的经验，写进规程。

shots.section_title: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动
shots.scene: 日历上几个红圈：六月、十一月九日、五月十二日
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with red circles on several dates. No people.
shots.narration: 我国有一串安全宣传的日子。
overlay: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动

shots.section_title: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动
shots.scene: 校园里的安全宣传展板和海报
shots.prompt_en: Safety exhibition boards and blank posters on a university campus square.
shots.narration: 提醒履行责任，提高安全意识。

shots.section_title: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动
shots.scene: 实验室安全月：疏散演练、隐患自查
shots.prompt_en: Lab safety month: students practice an evacuation drill and check a lab for hazards.
shots.narration: 安全月，组织演练、隐患自查。

shots.section_title: 安全日、安全月和宣传活动
shots.scene: 知识竞赛，学生抢答
shots.prompt_en: Students compete in a safety knowledge contest, raising answer paddles.
shots.narration: 办知识竞赛，答完讲清道理。

shots.scene: 共同习惯和没人看着的阿杰
shots.prompt_en: A group habit icon next to the young male student working safely alone.
shots.narration: 文化，是没人看着时你怎么做。

shots.scene: 领导示范、走到现场的老周
shots.prompt_en: The older man leading by example on the lab floor.
shots.narration: 负责人示范，人人有责，敢于叫停。

shots.scene: 友善提醒和组会分享
shots.prompt_en: A friendly reminder bubble and a group meeting sharing icon.
shots.narration: 友善提醒，分享经验，天天坚持。

shots.scene: 欣欣在宣传栏旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the safety bulletin board.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲人因与事故致因。
